info.title: On Workflow Runner API
info.description: Control-plane, job, workflow, connector, event, secret, artifact, and notification APIs. All application APIs are under /api/v1; /api is a compatibility alias. The OpenAPI document at /api/v1 is public. OIDC browser flows are handled separately. Active OIDC access tokens with the exact `admin` scope have platform-wide administrator authority on authenticated management APIs.

get.summary: Inspect a workflow invocation and its execution variants
get.description: Requires runs.view. Returns a distinct invocation ID and its addressed request-event ID, per-variant admission lifecycle and accepted/rejected decision, and run IDs without exposing captured request inputs. The invocation view reads current run status from the canonical run-detail API and refreshes it on workspace job-change notifications and stream reconnects.

200.description: Invocation revision, variant admission states, and related run IDs

get.description: Returns events in stable ascending storage-sequence order using explicit workspace-scoped Stream bindings. Legacy channelId event references are backfilled during migration. The opaque cursor is scoped to the authenticated workspace and channel.

parameters.description: Opaque continuation cursor scoped to this authenticated workspace and channel
